title: PDF Watermark Remover for Exported Page Images
description: Use this PDF watermark remover workflow on a page image you are authorized to edit. Export the page as JPG or PNG before uploading.
heading: PDF Watermark Remover for Authorized Page Images
intro: The current WatermarkGemini uploader does not accept PDF documents. Export the page you are permitted to edit as an image, process that single page image, and review it before rebuilding or sharing your document.

process.heading: How to Use the PDF Watermark Remover Workflow
process.intro: Convert one permitted PDF page to an image before using the tool.

steps.title: Export the PDF Page
steps.description: Save the page you are authorized to edit as JPG, PNG, or WEBP. Password-protected or restricted documents should not be bypassed.

steps.title: Upload the Page Image
steps.description: Upload one exported page image up to 10 MB, sign in with Google, and start processing.

steps.title: Review and Rebuild
steps.description: Check the returned page image carefully, then use your own document software if you need to place it back into a PDF.

faq.heading: Questions About the PDF Watermark Remover Workflow
faq.intro: Understand document limits and how to prepare a page image safely.

items.question: Can I upload a PDF directly?
items.answer: No. The current tool accepts JPG, PNG, or WEBP images only. Export the permitted PDF page as an image first.

items.question: Does the tool rebuild my PDF?
items.answer: No. It returns an image. Use document software separately if you need to create a new PDF from the processed page.

items.question: Can I process a protected document?
items.answer: Do not bypass document protections. Only edit a document when you own it or have explicit permission and the change complies with applicable rules.

items.question: Can I process multiple pages at once?
items.answer: No. The current workflow accepts one image at a time, up to 10 MB.
